curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: acknowledge the role of accurate pronunciation in oral communication.

interactions.prompt: You want soap, not soup. Which clear word should you say?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Accurate sounds help the listener bring soap.
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the long sound in soap.

interactions.prompt: Match each clearly spoken word to the right item.
interactions.feedback: Clear words carry the right meaning.
interactions.retryHint: Say the whole word, including its final sound.

interactions.prompt: Put the clear-speaking routine in order.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Listening, speaking clearly and checking make a strong message.
interactions.retryHint: Hear the model first, then speak, then check.

interactions.prompt: Which request is easiest to understand?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Every word and sound is clear.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the complete request that names the item accurately.

interactions.prompt: Your partner did not understand your word. What should you do?
choices: say it again slowly and clearly
interactions.answer: say it again slowly and clearly
interactions.feedback: Good choice! Careful pronunciation can repair a message.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the kind action that makes the same word clearer.

choices: it helps people understand our meaning
interactions.answer: it helps people understand our meaning
interactions.feedback: Clear-message champion! Accurate pronunciation supports communication.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what the listener needs from your words.
